partners.diseaseBName: complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations 7
partners.mechanism_chain: KIF7 (HGNC:24034) —DISRUPTS→ ciliogenesis (GO:0001538); ciliogenesis (GO:0001538) —LEADS_TO→ Acrocallosal syndrome (MONDO:0008708); KIF7 (HGNC:24034) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal corpus callosum morphology (HP:0002079); TUBB2B (HGNC:12003) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations 7 (MONDO:0012399); TUBB2B (HGNC:12003) —LEADS_TO→ Cortical dysplasia (HP:0033770). Loss-of-function mutations in KIF7 disrupt ciliogenesis, leading to acrocallosal syndrome, which includes abnormal corpus callosum morphology. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in TUBB2B disrupt cytoskeletal organization, causing complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations 7, characterized by cortical dysplasia. Both ciliogenesis and cytoskeletal organization are fundamental cellular processes critical for proper neurodevelopment, representing a shared mechanistic vulnerability.
